findings.scenario: ConfigReportCompositionTest boots TenancyServiceProvider through GoldenTestCase and asserts the full corex:config:validate report, including driver tenancy.wakeup.driver=root_registry, driver tenancy.oidc.enabled=false, and secret tenancy.oidc.client_secret=absent. It writes the OIDC overrides onto the tenancy key. TenancyConfigSection::drivers() prints driver corex-tenancy.wakeup.driver and driver corex-tenancy.oidc.enabled, and secretKeys() is corex-tenancy.oidc.client_secret; ValidateConfigCommand writes those strings verbatim. assertSame fails. composer test includes tests/Feature, and the CI Tests job runs composer test.
findings.evidence: tests/Feature/ConfigReportCompositionTest.php:14-37; tests/Golden/GoldenTestCase.php:52; packages/tenancy/src/Laravel/Support/TenancyConfigSection.php:25-40; packages/core/src/Config/Internal/Commands/ValidateConfigCommand.php:117-118 and :175-177; scripts/run-root-tests.sh:8; .github/workflows/ci.yml:61-62; composer.json script test

findings.scenario: The access README says the cloud OIDC lane of axiomasoft/corex-tenancy is under tenancy.oidc.enabled. TenancyServiceProvider::registrars() reads only corex-tenancy.oidc.enabled and adds AuthenticationRegistrar only when that value is true. An application that sets the key named in the access README leaves the OIDC registrar and routes/oidc.php unloaded.

The repository development block runs scripts/php84 python3 scripts/distribution/stage-stancl-providers.py before composer install, then unsets repositories.stancl-providers on the root, tenancy, and access manifests and runs the same script with --portable-locks after updates. This candidate deletes that script and the stancl provider repository, so the documented bootstrap stops on the missing file.
findings.evidence: README.md:47-61; product snapshot path scripts/distribution/stage-stancl-providers.py mode null; scripts/, .github/, composer.json, and packages/ contain no stancl references outside CHANGELOG.md
